channel.title: Kaitlin Isaac - Designer
channel.description: Welcome to Kaitlin Isaac - Designer! Follow along as I transition from the classroom to the world of UX design. Here, you'll find my reflections, learnings, and tips for anyone interested in design, technology, and the intersection between the two. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a beginner like me, I hope my journey can offer a fresh perspective on what it means to switch careers and embrace a life of continuous learning.

item.title: ux-work
item.dc:creator: kaitlinmisaac
item.content:encoded: This is my new "work" focus mode that automatically turns on between 9AM and 5PM. It features all of the apps I use to stay productive during the day!

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: A screenshot of an Apple iPhone Home Screen. The Notes widget is in the top left corner, the weather widget in the top right corner, the mail widget is in the middle, then two rows of apps at the bottom: Calendar, Mail, ToDoist, Notes, Reminders, LinkedIn, OnePassword, ChatGPT

item.title: band
item.dc:creator: kaitlinmisaac
item.content:encoded: This was my Work Focus Mode when I was a band teacher. I always had a metronome and tuner handy! I often used the translation apps with my students who spoke little to no English.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: A screenshot of an Apple iPhone home screen. The calendar widget in the top left corner, four apps in the top right corner: calendar, Tempo, Tonal Energy, and Translation. The weather app is below and then three more apps: Freeform, Voice Memos, and UDBand

A Screenshot of an Apple iPhone home screen with the large battery widget at the top, then a large Shopping List widget, then three apps: Crouton, ChatGPT, and Clock, then the YouTube widget in the bottom right corner
